findings.summary: The pinned, unchanged world-lab runtime-webgpu tests passed all 16 assertions in all three clean Dawn processes, including compute CPU/GPU parity, overflow behavior, generated fragment output readback, and shader validation.

All three Doe processes rejected unchanged generated vegetation WGSL at the large const-array declaration and exchanged.exchanged conditional, then produced zero candidates and a false overflow result where the upstream oracle expected two candidates and true overflow.

In all three Doe processes, the upstream deliberately invalid generated fragment shader produced zero compilation-info errors even though Doe's native diagnostics reported the missing params.p_n_const_value identifier; the same upstream assertion passed on Dawn.

The Doe Vitest worker exited before completing five fullscreen-fragment assertions in each clean process. The harness parent exited normally with a test failure rather than an operating-system signal, so this report does not classify the event as a process crash.
The physical render node was inaccessible, Dawn selected llvmpipe, and Doe did not complete the workload, so the observed process durations cannot support a speed comparison.

limitations: Doe did not complete the generated vegetation and fullscreen workloads, so provider output equivalence is not established.
The host denied access to /dev/dri/renderD128 and Dawn selected llvmpipe, so the run is not hardware-comparable.
The upstream test report does not emit dynamically assembled shader hashes, exact output bytes, or concrete vegetation workgroup counts.
The result covers three pinned runtime-webgpu consumer test files, not world-lab's complete WebGPU surface.

performance.reason: The comparison provider did not complete the workload and the baseline used a software renderer.

receiptOverhead.reason: The harness did not run matched traced and untraced workload pairs, and Doe did not complete the comparison workload.

installation.summary: The Vite provider alias is a controlled harness substitution, not a validated production installation path.

supportHardware.summary: The physical render node was inaccessible and Dawn selected llvmpipe.

concurrency.summary: The diagnostic matrix used sequential clean processes rather than concurrent workload execution.

teardown.summary: No promotion-scale teardown lane ran, and the Doe fullscreen worker exited before completing its assertions.

stress.summary: Three clean processes per provider establish diagnostic repeatability but do not satisfy the promotion stress policy.

memory.summary: Peak RSS was captured, but no bounded-growth leak test ran.

receipts.summary: The harness captured provider and adapter identities plus repeated assertion failures, but dynamic shader hashes, exact output bytes, concrete vegetation dispatch counts, and completed Doe outputs are absent.

performance.summary: The comparison did not complete and the incumbent used software rendering.

release.summary: The harness is not promoted and Doe does not yet pass its correctness boundary.
